format_pval_plain <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) {
    exp <- floor(log10(p))
    paste0("p < 1e", exp)
  } else {
    sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
  }
}

## Figure 7A: SLC6A8 expression

```{r}
plot_violin2 <- function(dge, gene, res) {

  lcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

  plot_df <- tibble(
    sample    = colnames(dge$counts),
    Condition = dge$samples$Condition,
    logCPM    = as.numeric(lcpm[gene, ])
  )

  plot_df$Condition <- gsub("Healthy", "Healthy pooled CD34+", plot_df$Condition)
  plot_df$Condition <- factor(plot_df$Condition,
                              levels = c("Healthy pooled CD34+", "AML"))

  fdr_plot <- signif(res$FDR[res$Symbol == gene], 2)
  lfc_plot <- signif(res$logFC[res$Symbol == gene], 2)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Condition, y = logCPM, fill = Condition)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2.3, alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.8, width = 1, scale = "width") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Healthy pooled CD34+" = "darkgrey",
                 "AML" = "#25769F")
    ) +
    labs(
      subtitle = paste0( "FDR=", fdr_plot, "\nLFC=", lfc_plot),
      x = NULL,
      y = if (gene == "DGKA") "" else "log2(CPM)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black")
    )
}
```

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=4}

  scale_x_discrete(labels= c("Healthy pooled\nCD34+", "AML"))

filename = "AML_healthy_SLC6A8_violin_expression.pdf"

ggsave(filename = file.path(params$fig_dir, filename),
       plot = out, width = 4, height = 4)
```

## Figure 7B

```{r}
library(readxl)
eryth_human_pang <- fread("../../beataml2_rnaseq/data/PanglaoDB_markers_27_Mar_2020.tsv") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(`cell type` == "Erythroid-like and erythroid precursor cells") %>%
  filter(
    grepl("Hs", species),
    !grepl("^HBB-|^HBA-|^HBB-B|^HBA-X", `official gene symbol`),
    sensitivity_human > 0 | `canonical marker` == 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Symbol = `official gene symbol`) %>%
  arrange(desc(sensitivity_human)) %>%
  distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)

eryth_cm <- read_excel("../../beataml2_rnaseq/data/Cell_marker_Human.xlsx") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("erythroid", cell_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(tissue_class %in% c("Blood", "Bone marrow"))
eryth_cm$Symbol[is.na(eryth_cm$Symbol)]  <- toupper(eryth_cm$marker)[is.na(eryth_cm$Symbol)]

panglao_clean <- eryth_human_pang %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Symbol,
    cell_type  = `cell type`,
    sensitivity_human,
    specificity_human,
    canonical_marker = `canonical marker`,
    ubiquitousness   = `ubiquitousness index`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    source     = "PanglaoDB",
    cell_type  = "Erythroid-like and erythroid precursor cells"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Symbol), Symbol != "")

cellmarker_clean <- eryth_cm %>%
  filter(
    species == "Human",
    !is.na(Symbol),
    Symbol != "",
    Symbol != "<NA>"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Symbol,
    cell_type = cell_name
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    source           = "CellMarker2",
    sensitivity_human = NA_real_,
    specificity_human = NA_real_,
    canonical_marker  = NA_real_,
    ubiquitousness    = NA_real_
  ) %>%
  distinct()

eryth_combined <- bind_rows(panglao_clean, cellmarker_clean) %>%
  group_by(Symbol) %>%
  mutate(
    n_sources    = n_distinct(source),
    in_both      = n_sources > 1,
    sources_list = paste(sort(unique(source)), collapse = " + ")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Symbol) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    cell_types       = paste(unique(cell_type), collapse = " | "),
    sources_list     = dplyr::first(sources_list),
    in_both          = dplyr::first(in_both),
    n_sources        = dplyr::first(n_sources),
    sensitivity_human = max(sensitivity_human, na.rm = TRUE),
    specificity_human = max(specificity_human, na.rm = TRUE),
    canonical_marker  = max(canonical_marker,  na.rm = TRUE),
    ubiquitousness    = max(ubiquitousness,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x), NA_real_, .x))) %>%
  arrange(desc(in_both), desc(sensitivity_human)) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_types_grouped= case_when(
      str_detect(cell_types, regex("CD34\\+|megakaryocyte-erythroid", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "CD34+/MEP erythroid progenitor",

      str_detect(cell_types, regex("erythroid-like|precursor|progenitor|immature", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "Erythroid precursor / immature",

      str_detect(cell_types, regex("erythroid cell", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "Erythroid cell",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    cell_types_grouped = factor(
      cell_types_grouped
    )
  ) %>%
  relocate(cell_types_grouped, .after = cell_types)

num_cols <- names(eryth_combined)[vapply(eryth_combined, is.numeric, logical(1))]

eryth_de_combined <- res %>%
  inner_join(
    eryth_combined %>%
      dplyr::select(Symbol, cell_types, cell_types_grouped, sources_list, in_both,
             sensitivity_human, canonical_marker),
    by = "Symbol"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC >  1 ~ "up",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < -1 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    confidence = case_when(
      in_both                       ~ "Both databases",
      sources_list == "PanglaoDB"   ~ "PanglaoDB only",
      sources_list == "CellMarker2" ~ "CellMarker2 only"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(logFC)
```

```{r}
eryth_de_show <- eryth_de_combined %>%
    dplyr::select(Symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val, sig, confidence,
           sensitivity_human, cell_types, cell_types_grouped) %>%
    arrange(logFC)

num_cols <- names(eryth_de_show)[vapply(eryth_de_show, is.numeric, logical(1))]

FC_THRESH  <- 1
FDR_THRESH <- 0.05

vol_df <- res %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < FDR_THRESH & logFC >  FC_THRESH ~ "up",
      adj.P.Val < FDR_THRESH & logFC < -FC_THRESH ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    is_eryth_de = Symbol %in% eryth_de_show$Symbol
  )

top_df <- filter(vol_df, is_eryth_de) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  head(5)

vol_df <- vol_df[-which(vol_df$Symbol == "SLC6A8"), ]

sig_counts <- vol_df %>%
  filter(sig != "ns") %>%
  dplyr::count(sig)

## PLOT =========================================================
p_volcano <- ggplot(vol_df, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_fdr)) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(vol_df, sig == "ns"),
    aes(color = "ns"), alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(vol_df, sig == "up"),
    aes(color = "Up"), alpha = 0.65, size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(vol_df, sig == "down"),
    aes(color = "Down"), alpha = 0.65, size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(vol_df, is_eryth_de),
    aes(color = "Erythroid"), size = 3.5,
    shape = 18
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c(
      "ns"        = "grey75",
      "Up"        = "#E05C5C",
      "Down"      = "#4A90D9",
      "Erythroid" = "#7C3393"
    ),
    guide = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        size  = c(3.5, 3.5, 2, 3.5),
        shape = c(16, 18, 16, 16),
        alpha = c(1, 1, 1, 1)
      )
    )
  )  +
  geom_label_repel(
    data        = top_df,
    aes(label   = Symbol),
    color       = "#7C3393",
    fill        = "white",
    fontface    = "bold",
    force = 3,
    force_pull = 0.1,
    size        = 3.5,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    seed        = 42
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(FDR_THRESH), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-FC_THRESH, FC_THRESH), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text",
    x = max(vol_df$logFC, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.45,
    y = max(vol_df$neg_log10_fdr, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
    label = paste0("Up: ", filter(sig_counts, sig == "up")$n),
    color = "#E05C5C", size = 5.6, hjust = 1
  ) +
  annotate("text",
    x = min(vol_df$logFC, na.rm = TRUE) * 1,
    y = max(vol_df$neg_log10_fdr, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
    label = paste0("Down: ", filter(sig_counts, sig == "down")$n),
    color = "#4A90D9", size = 5.6, hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = expression(log[2]*FC)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression(-log[10]*~FDR),
                     limits = c(-0.5, 20)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Differential expression — Erythroid markers",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "FDR < ", FDR_THRESH, "  |  |logFC/IQR| > ", FC_THRESH,
      "  |  n = ", nrow(vol_df), " genes"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle    = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 15,  color = "grey20"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.key.size  = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 4),
    legend.position  = "right"
  )

theme_pub <- function(...) {

    theme(
      legend.position  = "none",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 11),

stat_label <- function(vals, grps) {
  grps  <- droplevels(as.factor(grps))
  n_lvl <- nlevels(grps)
  if (n_lvl < 2) return(NULL)
  if (n_lvl == 2) {
    p    <- wilcox.test(vals ~ grps)$p.value
    test <- "Wilcoxon"
  } else {
    p    <- kruskal.test(vals ~ grps)$p.value
    test <- "Kruskal-Wallis"
  }
  if (p >= 0.05) return(NULL)
  lbl <- if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", signif(p, 2))
  paste0(test, ": ", lbl)
}

make_violin_continuous <- function(df, var, fill_col = "#4E79A7",
                                   exclude_vals = NULL,
                                   fill_pal = NULL,
                                   level_order = NULL) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(slc6a8_norm), !is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    mutate(grp = as.character(.data[[var]]))

  if (!is.null(exclude_vals))
    df2 <- df2 %>% filter(!grp %in% exclude_vals)

  df2 <- df2 %>%
    group_by(grp) %>%
    filter(n() >= 3) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (!is.null(level_order)) {
    df2 <- df2 %>% filter(grp %in% level_order)
    df2$grp <- factor(df2$grp, levels = level_order)
  } else {
    df2$grp <- factor(df2$grp, levels = sort(unique(df2$grp)))
  }

  stat_txt <- stat_label(df2$slc6a8_norm, df2$grp)

  p <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = grp, y = slc6a8_norm))

  if (!is.null(fill_pal)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_jitter(aes(colour = grp),
                  width = 0.18, size = 0.55, alpha = 0.35) +
      geom_boxplot(aes(fill = grp, colour = grp),
                   width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA,
                   alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values   = fill_pal) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = fill_pal)
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_jitter(color = fill_col,
                  width = 0.18, size = 0.55, alpha = 0.35) +
      geom_boxplot(fill = fill_col, colour = fill_col,
                   width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA,
                   alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.5)
  }

  p +
    labs(
      subtitle = stat_txt,
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "SLC6A8"
    ) +
    theme_pub()
}

meta <- dge_clinic$samples
meta$priorMDS[meta$priorMDS == "y"] <- "yes"
meta$priorMDS[meta$priorMDS == "n"] <- "no"

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(ELN2017_collapsed = case_when(
    ELN2017 %in% c("FavorableOrIntermediate",
                   "IntermediateOrAdverse",
                   "Intermediate")           ~ "Intermediate",
    ELN2017 == "Favorable"                   ~ "Favorable",
    ELN2017 == "Adverse"                     ~ "Adverse",
    TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_
  ))

p_cont <- list(

  ELNrisk = make_violin_continuous(
    meta, "ELN2017_collapsed",
    fill_pal     = pal_eln,
    level_order  = c("Favorable", "Intermediate", "Adverse"),
    exclude_vals = c("NonInitial", "NonAML", "MissingKaryo",
                     "MissingMutations", "", NA)
  ),

  priorMDS = make_violin_continuous(
    meta, "priorMDS",
    fill_pal    = pal_binary_ny,
    level_order = c("no", "yes")
  ),

  AMLfusion = make_violin_continuous(
    meta, "consensusAMLFusions",
    fill_col     = "#4E79A7",
    exclude_vals = c("N/A", "")
  ),

  FLT3 = make_violin_continuous(
    meta, "FLT3-ITD",
    fill_pal    = pal_binary,
    level_order = c("negative", "positive")
  ),

  ASXL1 = make_violin_continuous(
    meta, "ASXL1",
    fill_pal    = pal_binary,
    level_order = c("negative", "positive")
  ),

  TP53 = make_violin_continuous(
    meta, "TP53",
    fill_pal    = pal_binary,
    level_order = c("negative", "positive")
  ),

  FAB = make_violin_continuous(
    meta, "fabBlastMorphology",
    fill_col     = "#4E79A7",
    level_order  = c("M0_6", "M1", "M2", "M3", "M4", "M4eo", "M5_merged", "M7", "NOS"),
    exclude_vals = c("", NA)
    )
)
```

## Supp Fig S14E: SLC6A8 vs erythroid score, corrected for erythroid content

```{r}
plot_df <- erythroid_scores

ct        <- cor.test(plot_df$slc6a8_logcpm_resid_eryth_corrected, plot_df$eryth_resid_eryth_corrected,
                      method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
r_partial <- ct$estimate
p_val     <- ct$p.value

ann_label <- paste0(
  "r = ", sprintf("%.2f", r_partial), "\n",
  format_pval_plain(p_val)
)

p_eryth <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = slc6a8_logcpm_resid_eryth_corrected, y = eryth_resid_eryth_corrected)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 3.2, color = "#D96C6C") +
  geom_smooth(method    = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color     = "#D73027", fill = "#FDAE61",
              linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.42) +
  annotate("text",
           x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label     = ann_label,
           hjust     = 1.05, vjust = -0.25,
           size      = 5.5, color = "black", lineheight = 1.45) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle    = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "SLC6A8",
    y = "Erythroid score "
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.title    = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=3}

ggsave(filename = file.path(params$fig_dir, filename),
       plot = p_eryth, width = 5, height = 3)
```
